protocol.stage_1: 12 SWE-ContextBench Lite related tasks, repo-index recall versus no-context; continue only if resolved count is not lower
protocol.stage_2: only after stage 1 freezes, the same 12 tasks with procedures derived from 12 disjoint prior tasks; promote only at plus 2 resolved and zero unsafe procedure reuse
protocol.agent_model: Claude Sonnet 4.5 as specified by the preregistered plan
protocol.official_grader: SWEContextBench evaluation.sh Lite path and prebuilt jiayuanz3/swecontextbench images

required_before_execution: freeze the exact 12 evaluation task IDs and 12 disjoint experience task IDs
implement and test the MemPhant-to-agent prediction adapter without altering the official grader
freeze exact model ID, per-task turns and token ceilings, provider prices, total provider-attempt ceiling, Docker resource ceiling, and maximum USD spend
record explicit user authorization over those exact hashes and ceilings
validate authorization before reading provider credentials or starting a model-backed task
kill_predicates: official code, dataset, case, image, model, prompt, adapter, or grader identity drifts
a stage ceiling is exceeded or the next task would exceed it
any task lacks a complete provider-attempt and Docker-evaluation receipt
stage 1 resolves fewer tasks than no-context
stage 2 improves by fewer than two resolved tasks or has any unsafe procedure reuse
non_claim: The no-model smoke is not a benchmark run or a MemPhant result. This packet is intentionally non-executable until the remaining hashes and hard budgets are frozen and separately authorized.
